issue.title: Pager open still misses sase-1es targets at 2k-20k lines and code-sparse/100k never finishes

task_type_fields.impact: Opening very large documents in `sase pager`, `sase bead show`, `sase artifact read`, or an ACE-embedded pager still takes seconds (2k-20k lines) or never finishes (100k code-sparse). The epic goal of open time proportional to the screen is only partly met.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/pager/view.py on_mount / src/sase/pager/_screen_syntax.py publish; tests/perf/bench_pager.py open cases
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by sase-1es.6 (notes #3/#4) and sase-1es.8 (note #1) during epic sase-1es (plan:202610/pager_performance.md). The epic cut open time and memory a lot (2k code-sparse mount 8.13s -> 0.80s; 20k RSS 5.7GB -> 144-192MB). The phase virtual-body-widget open targets (headless, above the floor) are still missed:

| case | target | after (sase-1es.6/.8, shared loaded host) |
| 2k open | <= 250 ms | 0.80s code-sparse / 2.77s log-dense |
| 20k open | <= 600 ms | 6.04s code-sparse / 3.23s log-dense (build only 66-75 ms) |
| 100k code-sparse | <= 2 s | TIMEOUT (exceeded the 600s per-case budget) |
| 100k log-dense | <= 5 s | mount 20.5s, remount_100x30 9.75s, RSS 565MB, j/k medians 10-20ms |
| real-terminal first paint, 500 lines | <= 1.3 s | unmeasured (pty probe counts terminal-init bytes only) |

Document build is cheap (66-75 ms at 20k, 0.46s at 100k), so mount is dominated by something else. sase-1es.6 suspected the syntax-overlay publish plus host load. Key maxes also spike under contention (log-dense/20k ctrl+d max 0.57s, G 0.41s). Work items: re-bench on a quiet host; split syntax-publish time from open in the bench; profile code-sparse/100k to find why it never finishes when log-dense/100k does; then fix what dominates. The Rust per-link wire conversion is filed separately as a sase-core feature.

Repro: `just bench-pager --cases code-sparse,log-dense --ladder 2000,20000,100000 --no-cold` (100k needs a longer per-case timeout; see docs/perf_runbook.md "Pager bench").

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1es cut pager open time and memory sharply but recorded misses against every phase virtual-body-widget open target, plus a 100k code-sparse TIMEOUT, as follow-ups for its land agent.

payload.description: Rust per-link conversion dominates link-dense (log-dense) opens; sase-1fb covers the rest of the open cost
Same sase-1es bench misses; label-prefix key cost is tracked separately
